<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "The rings I am interested in are unavailable. What should I do?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Please contact us directly, and we will gladly add you to our waitlist. We'll notify you by email as soon as the ring becomes available. Please note that inventory cannot be held and will be available on a first-come, first-served basis."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How long does it take to receive my HTOP package?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Each package is shipped via USPS First Class Mail and will arrive within 1-3 business days. No signature is required."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How long can I keep the package for?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "You can keep your package for up to 7 days."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How do I return the HTOP package?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Use the included return label and envelope to package all four rings, and drop the package off at your nearest USPS office by the seventh day of your trial."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is my credit card charged the Home Try-On fee?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "The MiaDonna Home Try-On Program is free. However, to ensure the rings are returned, we charge your credit card $100.00 USD upfront ($25 per ring), which is refunded in full provided the rings are returned to us within the program timeline and in original, undamaged condition"
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How do I receive my refund when the HTOP is returned?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "After we receive and inspect your package, we will refund your $100.00 USD payment ($25 per ring) back to the original form of payment. Please allow 3-7 days for the refund to post to your account."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What size center stone will my rings have?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Center stone sizes vary, but our Home Try-On rings are often set with 1.0ct Round Cut center stones."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "The rings I am interested are not on Home Try On. When will these be added?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "We are doing our best to add every ring from our website to the Home Try-On program. Please let us know what rings you are interested in, and we will add you to the waitlist and contact you when they come in!"
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What stones are used for the home try-on program?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Our Home Try-On sample rings are made of alloy metal using high-quality cubic zirconia center and side stones."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What size(s) are the rings included within the HTOP?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "The ring sizes included in the HTOP package will vary depending on the chosen styles. However, the average size will be 6.5."
    }
  }]
}
</script>
